title: Scope Management Command Group (scope add, remove, list)
description: Implement the three scope subcommands. Adding or removing a scope modifies the account's Scopes list in accounts.json and sets NeedsReauth=true, triggering an automatic token refresh on the next api call. All scope commands enforce the ZohoCorp block.
prerequisiteState: Stories 1-5 complete. All account commands, ApiClient, and auto-refresh on NeedsReauth=true are working and tested.
goal: After 'zapi-cli scope add --scope ZohoDesk.Tickets.READ', the scope is added to the target account's scopes[] in accounts.json and needs_reauth is set to true. The next api call for that account triggers an automatic token refresh.
scope: Create src/ZapiCli/Commands/ScopeCommands.cs with three command classes.

ScopeAddSettings inherits GlobalSettings: [CommandOption("--scope")] required string Scope (req, may be comma-separated), [CommandOption("--account")] string? AccountOverride. Validate() rejects if Scope is null/empty (INVALID_ARGS).

ScopeAddCommand.ExecuteAsync: (1) Resolve account name (AccountOverride ?? IAccountStore.GetDefaultAsync().Name); (2) AccountStore.FindAsync (ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND if null); (3) ZohoCorpGuard.AssertNotZohoCorp(account.Email); (4) Parse comma-separated scope string into individual scope strings (trim whitespace); (5) Build updated Scopes list = existing + new ones (skip duplicates); (6) Set NeedsReauth = true; (7) Replace AccountEntry in AccountsRoot; (8) AccountStore.SaveAsync; (9) WriteJson({ status="ok", data = { account = account.Name, scopes = updatedScopes } }).
ScopeRemoveSettings inherits GlobalSettings: [CommandOption("--scope")] required string Scope (req, comma-separated), [CommandOption("--account")] string? AccountOverride.

ScopeRemoveCommand.ExecuteAsync: (1) Resolve account; (2) FindAsync (ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND if null); (3) ZohoCorpGuard.AssertNotZohoCorp; (4) Parse comma-separated scope string; (5) Build updated Scopes = existing minus removed scopes; (6) Set NeedsReauth = true (removing a scope also needs a token refresh to narrow permissions); (7) Replace AccountEntry; (8) SaveAsync; (9) WriteJson({ status="ok", data = { account, scopes = updatedScopes } }).
ScopeListCommand.ExecuteAsync: (1) Resolve account; (2) FindAsync (ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND if null); (3) ZohoCorpGuard.AssertNotZohoCorp; (4) WriteJson(account.Scopes) — plain JSON array of scope strings.
Register all three commands under the 'scope' branch in Program.cs CommandApp.

Unit tests: scope add adds comma-separated scopes individually; scope add deduplicates existing scopes; scope add sets NeedsReauth=true; scope remove removes correct scopes; scope remove sets NeedsReauth=true; scope list returns scopes array; scope add with ZohoCorp account → ACCOUNT_DOMAIN_BLOCKED; scope add with missing --scope → INVALID_ARGS.
acceptanceCriteria: dotnet build succeeds with 0 errors and 0 warnings
scope add --scope ZohoDesk.Tickets.READ adds the scope to accounts.json and sets needs_reauth=true
scope add --scope 'ZohoDesk.Tickets.READ,ZohoDesk.Reports.READ' adds both scopes individually
scope add does not add duplicate scopes if the scope already exists
scope remove removes the specified scope(s) from accounts.json and sets needs_reauth=true
scope list --account work returns a JSON array of scope strings
scope add with a ZohoCorp-domain account → ACCOUNT_DOMAIN_BLOCKED, accounts.json unchanged
scope add/remove/list with nonexistent account → ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND
After scope add sets NeedsReauth=true, the next api call (Story 5) triggers auto-refresh (integration: end-to-end verified)
contextForAgent: Read ADR-0002 §Scope Change + Re-auth Flow for the full scope management design. The key invariant: any scope add OR remove sets NeedsReauth=true — even removing a scope requires a new token (narrowed permissions). The scope list/output is a plain JSON array (not wrapped in { status, data }). ZohoCorpGuard must fire in ALL three scope commands — even scope list (read-only). The comma-separated scope string in --scope should be split by comma and each part trimmed of whitespace before processing. Multiple --scope calls with the same values should be idempotent (no duplicate scopes added).

openItems.defaultAssumption: Yes — removing a scope also sets NeedsReauth=true. Rationale: narrowing OAuth token permissions requires issuing a new token with the reduced scope set. The existing token still has the old (broader) permissions until a refresh issues a new narrower one.
